newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-HUMPHREYS RETURNS TO CAPTAIN WALES.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-HUMPHREYS RETURNS TO CAPTAIN WALES.

text.p: Hooker Jonathan Humphreys returns as Wales' captain in one of two changes to the team to meet Scotland at Murrayfield on Saturday in the opening round of the Five Nations' championship.
Humphreys missed last Saturday's 34-14 victory over the United States through suspension.
Welsh record points scorer Neil Jenkins, who needs just two points to reach 500 in international rugby, has been recalled at full-back in place of Justin Thomas.
Swansea fly-half Arwel Thomas retains his place at the expense of 34-year-old Jonathan Davies who will be on the replacements' bench.

Wales - Neil Jenkins; Ieuan Evans, Scott Gibbs, Allen Bateman, Gareth Thomas; Arwel Thomas, Rob Howley; Scott Quinnell, Steve Williams, Colin Charvis, Mark Rowley, Gareth Llewellyn, David Young, Jonathan Humphreys (captain), Christian Loader.
